name: James Jr.
livingEvidence: The tree marks him 'James (Living)'. John T. Petriello Sr.'s March 2025 obituary (site facts) names a surviving brother 'Jim Petriello (wife MaryEllen)'. He was not yet born in April 1950 (the census shows only John and Ann Marie), so he was born after 1950 and is presumed living. Probably the same person as M0004.

sources.citation: Solfanelli-Fiorillo Funeral Home, obituary listing for John T. Petriello Sr. (1932-2025); survivors as recorded in the site facts
